one_liner: A hard-working, pragmatic 'locodol' who races and sings to put her hometown Tomakomai, Hokkaido, on the map.
personality: Hokko Tarumae is a diligent, realistic local idol and Tomakomai tourism ambassador who turns every event, snack time and outfit into hometown PR (haskap berries, surf clams, swans). She is polite and serious, plans everything, believes in effort rather than luck, and is often exasperated by Copano Rickey's feng shui. She used to shoulder Tomakomai's fate alone; with her trainer she learns to share the load, and she keeps workshopping cutesy dialect catchphrases, then second-guessing them.

story_arc.summary: Tarumae comes from Tomakomai to race on dirt (Leopard Stakes, Champions Cup, Kawasaki Kinen, Kashiwa Kinen, Teio Sho, JBC Classic, Tokyo Daishoten) so her wins and concerts will draw attention to her struggling hometown. At first she tries to save Tomakomai single-handedly; with her trainer she learns it is a 'three-legged race' and that it's fine to be her serious, stiff self (voice_id 70001, 10002). Event titles also include a challenge from Smart Falcon and scenes in Paris (パリの街にて), but their content is not in the mdb.

最速ロコドル、苫小牧から
参上だべ～☆…よし、決まった！
sample_lines.en: The fastest locodol, here from Tomakomai! ...Okay, nailed it!

sample_lines.jp:
とまこま～☆…この挨拶、悪くない
かもしれません。トレーナーさん、
とまこま～☆…どうでしょう！？
sample_lines.en: Tomakoma~! ...This greeting might not be bad. Trainer-san, tomakoma~! ...How's that!?

sample_lines.jp:
あの頃は1人で気負い過ぎて
いました。私が苫小牧を救うんだ、
って…今は、二人三脚です。
sample_lines.en: Back then I was carrying too much by myself. Thinking I'd be the one to save Tomakomai... Now it's a three-legged race.

sample_lines.jp:
私は私でいい。真面目で堅い私でも
いい。…ふふ。トレーナーさんと
いて、見つけた答えですよ。
sample_lines.en: It's fine for me to be me. Even a serious, stiff me. ...Heh. That's the answer I found being with you, Trainer-san.

sample_lines.jp:
元気が、出ません…。
かくなる上は…お仕事モード！
なんまら～…けっぱるべッ！
sample_lines.en: I've got no energy... In that case, work mode! Nanmara... kepparu-be!

sample_lines.jp:
リッキーってば、海にも風水道具を
持ってくるんですよ。…落として
泣きついてきても知らないんだから
sample_lines.en: Rickey even brings her feng-shui gear to the beach. ...If she drops it and comes crying to me, I'm not helping.
